args: variants --msa msa.fasta -r ref --reference-fasta ref.fasta
exit: 1
--- stderr
Error: give only one of --reference and --reference-fasta
Usage:
  gofasta variants [flags]

Flags:
      --msa string               Multiple sequence alignment in fasta format (default "stdin")
  -r, --reference string         The ID of the reference record in the msa
      --reference-fasta string   Reference sequence in a fasta file of its own, the same width as the msa (instead of --reference)
  -a, --annotation string        GenBank or GFF3 annotation file, its format taken from its suffix: .gb, .gbk, .gbff, .gff or .gff3 (optionally followed by .gz)
      --genbank string           GenBank annotation file, whatever it is called (instead of --annotation)
      --gff string               GFF3 annotation file, whatever it is called (instead of --annotation)
  -o, --outfile string           Name of the file of variants to write (default "stdout")
      --start int                Only report variants with a reference base at or after this position (default -1)
      --end int                  Only report variants with a reference base at or before this position (default -1)
      --aggregate                Report the proportions of each change
      --threshold float          If --aggregate, only report changes with a freq greater than or equal to this value
      --append-snps              Report the codon's SNPs in parenthesis after each amino acid mutation
  -t, --threads int              Number of threads to use (default 1)
      --strict                   Stop with an error at the first record that can't be processed, instead of warning and skipping it
  -h, --help                     help for variants
